meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动分析你的代码库，从 9 个维度（如架构、类型、测试等）找出技术债务，并生成一份带有严重等级、修复耗时和优先级排序的审计报告文件（TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md）。
howto.when: 当你要求进行代码库健康检查、技术债务审计、架构评审、代码质量评估或清理规划时，或者提到“技术债务”、“代码健康”、“审计”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 审计我们项目的技术债务。
say.note: Claude 会执行深度审计并生成报告。

say.text: 检查代码库的健康状况。
分析代码质量，找出需要改进的地方。
say.note: 从多维度给出具体修复建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically analyze your codebase across 9 dimensions (architecture, types, tests, etc.) to find technical debt and produce an audit report (TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md) with severity ratings, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, cleanup planning, or mention 'tech debt', 'code health', 'audit', etc.

say_en.note: Claude runs deep audit and generates report.

say_en.text: Analyze code quality and find improvements.
say_en.note: Provides specific recommendations from multiple dimensions.
